source: NYNZ 0.4.1 production validation, Saffron Loom build d4693669 (2026-11-05)

plan.summary: A frontend-only boutique orders app with a landing page and an orders workspace, using fictional data persisted in browser localStorage. No backend, authentication or payments.
steps: Landing page: top navigation with the Saffron Loom brand, Collections, Workspace and About links, and an Open workspace button. On phones the links collapse into a menu button that opens and closes the menu, closes on Escape and closes when a link is chosen.
Hero: headline, short paragraph, two buttons and a CSS-built preview panel mimicking order cards, followed by a section of three feature cards.

Workspace: opened from Open workspace, with a header showing the brand and a Back to home button, and an Orders page showing 9 fictional orders as cards with customer, date, items, INR total and a New, Packed or Delivered status badge.
Orders layout: a grid of at least three columns on wide screens and a single column on phones, with a status filter (All, New, Packed, Delivered) above the cards.
New order form: customer, item, quantity and price fields with validation. Submitting adds a new card with status New, and all orders persist across reloads via localStorage.
Visual direction: warm saffron, deep indigo and cream palette with a serif display font for headings and a clean sans-serif for body text, with visible focus states and responsive spacing.

proposal: Here is the proposed plan for Saffron Loom. It is frontend-only, so orders are fictional and stored in your browser's localStorage. Please review it and let me know if you'd like any changes before I write code.
